photos.c: One lap ace Geoff Dearman takes a breather after another brilliant 4 x 400 metre relay leg.

Below: Du'aine Ladejo, Matt Douglas, Geoff Dearman and Sean Baldock (still breathing hard after his last leg stint) enjoy the attention after providing the most dominating display of the evening. It was Du'aine's last race before signing for Birchfield Harriers.

Above: Geoff Dearman was in great form and looking for a sub-46 split in the 4 x 400m to give him a boost for the following week's AAA and Olympic Trials. Seconds after this picture was taken, as he entered the back straight, tragedy struck and a damaged hamstring put him out for the rest of the season.
